Senior Backend Engineer — Bengaluru (Hybrid)

About the role
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our payments team in Bengaluru.
This is a hybrid role: three days a week in our Whitefield office.

What you'll need
- 5+ years of experience building production backend services
- Strong Python
- Solid PostgreSQL — schema design, query tuning
- Experience with Docker and building REST APIs

Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- Exposure to Kafka or another event streaming system
- Prior fintech or payments experience

About you
You care about correctness, you write tests, and you can explain a tradeoff.
